{{Top}}
{{Quote|Several years ago, a group of zealous planetary ecologists transplanted the avian ''elix'' to Dar'Or. The elix inhabited a forest world about to be destroyed by a supernova explosion. By transplanting this small bird of prey to Dar'Or, the ecologists hoped to save the species from extinction. The well-meaning ecologists missed one important ecological computation and, consequently, were not aware of the full implications of their actions.|Obo Rin, ''Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy'', Revised Edition|<ref name="GG42">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
[[File:Patoado1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Ithorian Pato Ado was an ecologist.]]
An '''ecologist''' was a specialist who [[Scientist/Legends|studied]] the ecology of a given [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was [[The galaxy/Legends|galactically]] renowned as skilled ecologists. Ecologists played a part in the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] process of the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==Description==
An ecologist was a specialist who [[Scientist/Legends|studied]] the ecology of a given [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref> Ecologists endorsed [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] as long as it targeted specimens of overpopulated [[Species/Legends|species]] or rogue [[Diet/Legends|predators]] who preyed on [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> An ecologist could give valuable input during the process of [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] a planet.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

==History==
===Under the Republic===
{{Quote|He was a botanist and a savant. A Jedi Master of great age, we've heard; a Ho'Din from the planet Moltok. We've deduced by the growth of the lichens at the foot of the walls that he built this place about a hundred years ago, and since many of the plants that grow in the valley have been genetically tailored to our climate of geothermic heat and low light&mdash;even to the microclimates of high acidity down in the more active lower end of the valley&mdash;we assume he was an ecologist and scientist of considerable skill.|[[Jevax]], on Plett|<ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
After the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] had been [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]]<ref name="CCW" /> by a [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] expedition from the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27,500 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a group of affluent [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] families known as [[the Ten]] hired the best terraformers, ecologists, and animal [[Reproduction/Legends|breeders]] to turn the barren Kuat into a paradise-like world. Those efforts then saw fruition within two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]].<ref name="CCW" /> The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], a sentient species from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], made first contact with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at some point by [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> They frequently worked as ecologists and were renowned as potentially the best specialists of that type in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="RPG2ERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

[[File:FrolickingPuppy-KOTOR2.png|thumb|left|300px|A herd of Ithorians was recruited to help with the restoration of the planet Telos IV (pictured) due to the species' reputation as skilled ecologists.]]
At some point between [[3955 BBY]] and [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="TelosDates">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' dates the beginning of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] initiative that included the [[Telosian Restoration Project]] to [[3955 BBY]], and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] initiated a [[Telosian Restoration Project|project]] to restore the ecology of the [[Bombing of Telos IV|bombarded]] planet [[Telos IV]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]].<ref name="EAOC Telos">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Telos system/Legends|Telos system]]</ref> Due to the Ithorians' reputation as ecologists and [[Agronomist|agricultural engineers]], the [[Telosian Council]] recruited a [[Chodo Habat's herd|herd]] of Ithorians to help with the restoration efforts. The herd included the ecologist and [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Pato Ado]], who was sent to the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="KotOR2" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> to catalogue its natural resources.<ref name="KotOR2" /> The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]] was also a skilled ecologist who was active on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]<ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> approximately a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to<ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi" /> [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="12 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].</ref>

===Empire and beyond===
At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a group of planetary ecologists transplanted the small [[Bird/Legends|birds]] of prey known as the [[elix]] from their [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Unidentified elix homeworld|homeworld]]&mdash;which was about to be destroyed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]&mdash; to [[Dar'Or]], a planet located in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="GG42" /> of the Outer Rim.<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The ecologists, however, overlooked the fact that the new [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the elix had lower [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], which led to the avians becoming powerful and fast apex predators that threatened the native sentient [[Ri'Dar]] species. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after the transplantation of the elix from their doomed homeworld, the [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] mentioned the ecologists' deed&mdash;while characterizing them as "zealous"&mdash;in an entry of his publication, ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'', dedicated to the Ri'Dar.<ref name="GG42" />

[[File:Bersin_Sekolah.png|thumb|right|300px|Bersin Sekolah, a renowned Ithorian ecologist]]
A group of members of the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] species established the settlement known as [[Refuge City]] on the Caamasi homeworld,<ref name="CCW" /> the Core Worlds<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] with the goal of researching potential ways to decontaminate the world after its [[Caamas Firestorm|devastation]]<ref name="CCW" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> Refuge City was inhabited by approximately two hundred Caamasi as well as several dozen Ithorian ecologists&mdash;including [[Ish'tay]]&mdash;several of whom maintained a [[Garden/Legends|garden]] at the center of the settlement.<ref name="CCW" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Ithorian [[Bersin Sekolah]] was a renowned ecologist who had previously worked as a Galactic Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]].<ref name="Journal15" /> The Ithorian ecologist [[Chandra Hobat]] served as the [[President/Legends|President]] of the [[Kathol Republic]] during the [[New Republic era|existence]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="LittleEmpires">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Little Empires|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>

The [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] [[Amisus Funti]] was an ecologist who at some point taught at [[Garqi Agricultural University]] on the planet [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] of the Outer Rim's [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin sector]]. In turn, [[Nozho University]] on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], a planet in<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]]<ref name="EAOC Clak'dor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Colu system]]</ref> of the Outer Rim that was the homeworld of the sentient [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] species, hosted an [[Local year|annual]] ecological symposium, during which ecologists presented and defended scientific theses to each other. The symposium culminated with those same ecologists performing an improvised orchestral [[Music/Legends|concert]].<ref name="GatORW" /> At one point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], the Ithorians' frequent employment as ecologists was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the galaxy that was based on the research notes of sentientologist [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Ithorians are well-known as ecologists and agricultural engineers.|[[Moza]], in a possible conversation with the player character ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords''|<ref name="KotOR2" />}}
[[File:Gg4-1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'' introduced ecologists in ''Star Wars''.]]
The occupation of ecologist was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise via ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG41">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> The ecologist Plett then made a full appearance, albeit as part of a vision, in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="ChildrenOfTheJedi" /> Finally, [[Lisa Smedman]]'s [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Little Empires]]," published in the [[1996]] West End Games supplement ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'',<ref name="KatholOutback">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref> featured the first illustration of an ecologist, Chandra Hobat.<ref name="LittleEmpires" />

The occupation of ecologist was to be mentioned in the roleplaying source article "[[Corellian Translines (article)|Corellian Translines]]," which was written by [[Chris Hind]] and would have been published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 16|sixteenth issue]] of West End Games' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine before that issue's cancellation. In the article, a section representing an [[in-universe]] advertisement for the [[Corellian Translines]] company would have mentioned Ithorian and Ho'Din ecologists managing a biosphere resort aboard the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Empress (starship)|''Empress'']].<ref name="Journal16">{{JournalCite|16|Corellian Translines (article)}}</ref>
